00076 // General case
00077 template <int LL2>
00078 void    FFTRealFixLen <LL2>::do_fft (DataType f [], const DataType x [])
00079 {
00080     assert (f != 0);
00081     assert (x != 0);
00082     assert (x != f);
00083     assert (FFT_LEN_L2 >= 3);
00084 
00085     // Do the transform in several passes
00086     const DataType  *   cos_ptr = &_trigo_data [0];
00087     const long *    br_ptr = &_br_data [0];
00088 
00089     FFTRealPassDirect <FFT_LEN_L2 - 1>::process (
00090         FFT_LEN,
00091         f,
00092         &_buffer [0],
00093         x,
00094         cos_ptr,
00095         TRIGO_TABLE_ARR_SIZE,
00096         br_ptr,
00097         &_trigo_osc [0]
00098     );
00099 }

00101 // 4-point FFT
00102 template <>
00103 void    FFTRealFixLen <2>::do_fft (DataType f [], const DataType x [])
00104 {
00105     assert (f != 0);
00106     assert (x != 0);
00107     assert (x != f);
00108 
00109     f [1] = x [0] - x [2];
00110     f [3] = x [1] - x [3];
00111 
00112     const DataType  b_0 = x [0] + x [2];
00113     const DataType  b_2 = x [1] + x [3];
00114     
00115     f [0] = b_0 + b_2;
00116     f [2] = b_0 - b_2;
00117 }
00118 
00119 // 2-point FFT
00120 template <>
00121 void    FFTRealFixLen <1>::do_fft (DataType f [], const DataType x [])
00122 {
00123     assert (f != 0);
00124     assert (x != 0);
00125     assert (x != f);
00126 
00127     f [0] = x [0] + x [1];
00128     f [1] = x [0] - x [1];
00129 }
00130 
00131 // 1-point FFT
00132 template <>
00133 void    FFTRealFixLen <0>::do_fft (DataType f [], const DataType x [])
00134 {
00135     assert (f != 0);
00136     assert (x != 0);
00137

00143 // General case
00144 template <int LL2>
00145 void    FFTRealFixLen <LL2>::do_ifft (const DataType f [], DataType x [])
00146 {
00147     assert (f != 0);
00148     assert (x != 0);
00149     assert (x != f);
00150     assert (FFT_LEN_L2 >= 3);
00151 
00152     // Do the transform in several passes
00153     DataType *      s_ptr =
00154         FFTRealSelect <FFT_LEN_L2 & 1>::sel_bin (&_buffer [0], x);
00155     DataType *      d_ptr =
00156         FFTRealSelect <FFT_LEN_L2 & 1>::sel_bin (x, &_buffer [0]);
00157     const DataType  *   cos_ptr = &_trigo_data [0];
00158     const long *    br_ptr = &_br_data [0];
00159 
00160     FFTRealPassInverse <FFT_LEN_L2 - 1>::process (
00161         FFT_LEN,
00162         d_ptr,
00163         s_ptr,
00164         f,
00165         cos_ptr,
00166         TRIGO_TABLE_ARR_SIZE,
00167         br_ptr,
00168         &_trigo_osc [0]
00169     );
00170 }

00172 // 4-point IFFT
00173 template <>
00174 void    FFTRealFixLen <2>::do_ifft (const DataType f [], DataType x [])
00175 {
00176     assert (f != 0);
00177     assert (x != 0);
00178     assert (x != f);
00179 
00180     const DataType  b_0 = f [0] + f [2];
00181     const DataType  b_2 = f [0] - f [2];
00182 
00183     x [0] = b_0 + f [1] * 2;
00184     x [2] = b_0 - f [1] * 2;
00185     x [1] = b_2 + f [3] * 2;
00186     x [3] = b_2 - f [3] * 2;
00187 }
00188 
00189 // 2-point IFFT
00190 template <>
00191 void    FFTRealFixLen <1>::do_ifft (const DataType f [], DataType x [])
00192 {
00193     assert (f != 0);
00194     assert (x != 0);
00195     assert (x != f);
00196 
00197     x [0] = f [0] + f [1];
00198     x [1] = f [0] - f [1];
00199 }
00200 
00201 // 1-point IFFT
00202 template <>
00203 void    FFTRealFixLen <0>::do_ifft (const DataType f [], DataType x [])
00204 {
00205     assert (f != 0);
00206     assert (x != 0);
00207     assert (x != f);
00208 
00209     x [0] = f [0];

00215 template <int LL2>
00216 void    FFTRealFixLen <LL2>::rescale (DataType x []) const
00217 {
00218     assert (x != 0);
00219 
00220     const DataType  mul = DataType (1.0 / FFT_LEN);
00221 
00222     if (FFT_LEN < 4)
00223     {
00224         long                i = FFT_LEN - 1;
00225         do
00226         {
00227             x [i] *= mul;
00228             --i;
00229         }
00230         while (i >= 0);
00231     }
00232 
00233     else
00234     {
00235         assert ((FFT_LEN & 3) == 0);
00236 
00237         // Could be optimized with SIMD instruction sets (needs alignment check)
00238         long                i = FFT_LEN - 4;
00239         do
00240         {
00241             x [i + 0] *= mul;
00242             x [i + 1] *= mul;
00243             x [i + 2] *= mul;
00244             x [i + 3] *= mul;
00245             i -= 4;
00246         }
00247         while (i >= 0);
00248     }
00249 }

00261 template <int LL2>
00262 void    FFTRealFixLen <LL2>::build_br_lut ()
00263 {
00264     _br_data [0] = 0;
00265     for (long cnt = 1; cnt < BR_ARR_SIZE; ++cnt)
00266     {
00267         long                index = cnt << 2;
00268         long                br_index = 0;
00269 
00270         int             bit_cnt = FFT_LEN_L2;
00271         do
00272         {
00273             br_index <<= 1;
00274             br_index += (index & 1);
00275             index >>= 1;
00276 
00277             -- bit_cnt;
00278         }
00279         while (bit_cnt > 0);
00280 
00281         _br_data [cnt] = br_index;
00282     }
00283 }

00287 template <int LL2>
00288 void    FFTRealFixLen <LL2>::build_trigo_lut ()
00289 {
00290     const double    mul = (0.5 * PI) / TRIGO_TABLE_ARR_SIZE;
00291     for (long i = 0; i < TRIGO_TABLE_ARR_SIZE; ++ i)
00292     {
00293         using namespace std;
00294 
00295         _trigo_data [i] = DataType (cos (i * mul));
00296     }
00297 }

00301 template <int LL2>
00302 void    FFTRealFixLen <LL2>::build_trigo_osc ()
00303 {
00304     for (int i = 0; i < NBR_TRIGO_OSC; ++i)
00305     {
00306         OscType &       osc = _trigo_osc [i];
00307 
00308         const long      len = static_cast <long> (TRIGO_TABLE_ARR_SIZE) << (i + 1);
00309         const double    mul = (0.5 * PI) / len;
00310         osc.set_step (mul);
00311     }
00312 }
